newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS to raise freight rates by 7-10 percent.
newsitem.headline: SAS to raise freight rates by 7-10 percent.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines Service (SAS) said on Tuesday that it planned to follow partner Lufthansa's lead and raise freight charges by between seven and ten percent but would not be able to do so when Lufthansa introduces its next rate update in March.

"We will not make it by March 1," SAS Cargo sales director Jan Hagen told reporters at a briefing on the recent extension of the SAS-Lufthansa passenger alliance to the carriers' freight operations. He did not say when the increase would take effect.
Hagen said that in future SAS Cargo would synchronise rate changes with Lufthansa, updating prices every March and October.
